commands: set `proposals` to include ecp384 or modp4096, remove the weak group
problem_analysis: Diffie-Hellman group negotiated is Group 14 (MODP-2048) or lower. DISA SRG mandates Group 16 (MODP-4096) or ECP-384.
cryptographic_risk: MODP-2048 provides only ~112 bits of classical security margin and is acutely vulnerable to nation-state Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) attacks.
proposed_strategy: Replace modp1024/1536/2048 proposals with modp4096, preserving encryption and integrity algorithms.
rollback_strategy: Snapshot of every swanctl config file first (and of the lab peer's, if it is touched), plus a Commit-Confirmed Watchdog inside the container that restores the snapshot on its own if the change is not verified within 180 s. A failed or regressing verification restores immediately, and the restored files are checked byte for byte against the originals.
scope: Only the t-tun connection is changed, on the chosen lab container and on the other end of the lab tunnel, because that is the tunnel captured and verified.
